name: value-to-market
description: The Value-to-Market (V2M) Framework as a plugin. Run v2m-init once per project, then v2m-value-strategy any time; v2m-value-to-market-run builds a Masterplan and launches seven phase sets (Assess, Strategy, Customer & Fit, Design, Market, Engineer, Deliver). Every step writes a reasoning file plus a branded Word report (Excel when list-heavy), self-scores, and returns one recommendation. Skills namespaced v2m-.
